headline: 2027: Uzodimma backs Tinubu’s re-election, urges patience with reforms
summary: Imo Governor Hope Uzodimma defended Nigerian President Tinubu's petrol subsidy removal as necessary, saying it freed funds for states and urging honest communication on reform.
why: Petrol subsidy removal changes fuel prices and government spending in Nigeria, a major oil producer. Policy continuity affects investor confidence in reform.
